waybackify remaster verify [flags]

Prove a remastered tree stands alone (no archive.org)

Validate a remastered root, read-only, in two tiers. STATIC (always):
scan every text body for web.archive.org / archive.org / absolute
wayback-shaped escapes (zero allowlist), and check determinism — every
body hashes to its build-record outputHash, and (given --hermetic) a
fresh rebuild reproduces the committed build record byte-for-byte.
DYNAMIC (--tier dynamic, requires agent-browser): render documents
through a strict server with non-local origins abort-routed — a
document passes iff it made zero non-local requests, raised zero CSP
violations, and every local ref resolves in the corpus.

Output: a per-tier report on stdout (--json for the raw report). Exit
0 clean, 1 on any finding.

Flags:
  --root|-r <root>    the remastered tree to validate (cap/ + meta/ + remaster.build.json) — required
  --hermetic <root>   the sealed source, for the determinism rebuild (else reproducibility is skipped)
  --tier <list>       comma list of {static,dynamic}; default static
  --sample <n>        dynamic tier: render only the first N HTML documents
  --no-determinism    skip the rebuild half of the static determinism check
  --json              emit the raw report as JSON
  --out <path>        also write the report to this file
  --help|-h           Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
